subject.title: fix(telegram): DM lane stays dead after a wedged handler keeps it guarded; escalate to a supervised gateway restart

question: Should `ChannelAccountSnapshot.processRestartRequired` become the permanent generic channel contract for unrecoverable in-process wedges, or should Telegram request gateway recovery through a narrower owner-specific seam?
rationale: Both designs can preserve the safe process-replacement boundary, but choosing a new cross-channel plugin contract and whole-gateway recovery policy requires maintainer intent rather than automated review judgment.

options.title: Approve the generic contract
options.body: Keep the current plugin-owned detection and generic snapshot signal, allowing other channels to use the same supervised recovery policy later.

options.title: Use a Telegram-owned seam
options.body: Replace the exported snapshot field with a narrow injected restart-request path owned by Telegram while retaining the same gateway scheduler and limiter.

options.title: Pause automatic recovery
options.body: Leave current manual gateway restart behavior in place if whole-process escalation is not an acceptable channel-health responsibility.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the current plugin-owned detection and generic snapshot signal, allowing other channels to use the same supervised recovery policy later.

likelyOwner.reason: The discussion identifies this person with the Telegram spool and polling lifecycle where the contract originates.
